\caption{Log-determinant: certified approximation ratio of random greedy (RG, mean over trials) with respect to each upper bound, as a function of the cardinality $k$. $f(S)=\log\det(L_S)$, $L=\alpha(K+10^{-3}I)$ with an RBF kernel $K$ on the features. RG/OPT uses the exact optimum (brute force) where it was computable. On the largest instances the dual bound is minimized over every 5th greedy prefix only. Additional baselines: the LP over the dual's base sets (B2), the pruned double-greedy bound $\gamma_1$ (B3) and the modular bounds $\mu_2$, $\mu_3$ on the pruned lattice (B4); B3 and B4 bound the unconstrained optimum. Marginal is $\min_S f(S)+\mathrm{Pen}(S)+\sum_{a\in T_k(S)}[f(a\mid S)]^+$ ($T_k(S)$: the $k$ largest marginals) over the same base sets, i.e.\ the dual bound without its caps. Hybrid (B5) is the LP B2 strengthened with the dual's prefix caps, and min(dual, B5) the smaller of the dual bound and B5. Curves are means over graph/sample seeds.}
\label{fig:rg-log_det-wide-hybrid}
\end{figure*}
